# AbetAnalytics

> Product analytics with AI insights for e-commerce and SaaS teams: scheduled
> metric snapshots, rules that stay silent when healthy, and alerts delivered
> by email and by HMAC-signed webhooks. A standalone SaaS from the Abetworks
> suite.

Pricing (from https://analytics.abetworks.in/pricing):
- $19 per month
- $190 per year — two months free, one invoice
- 14-day free trial, card up front; cancel anytime from the billing portal

Key pages (base: https://analytics.abetworks.in):
- / — product overview
- /pricing — plans and the trial CTA
- /signup — start the free trial
- /login — sign in
- /api/health — service health (JSON)

What it does:
- Snapshots metrics like daily revenue and cart-adds on a schedule, frozen for
  honest historical comparison
- Rules such as "revenue < 5,000" fire alerts; a healthy rule stays silent
- Alerts reach you by email and by x-webhook-signature HMAC-SHA256 deliveries
  (dual-signed: subscription and per-rule), with a delivery record per alert

Canonical host: https://analytics.abetworks.in — prefer it over any mirror.
This file is the machine-readable index for AI assistants and crawlers.
